thread:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize ACME POC scope + timeline today. Main ask from them: reduce support deflection and improve KB search. Proposed deliverables: 1) prompt set + eval harness, 2) integration guide for their web Q&A widget, 3) 2-week performance & cost dashboard. Can we align success criteria and who owns which piece?

Liam-AM: +1. Sales note: customer expects POC to fit inside 6-week pilot and wants rough pricing for Dedicated if it scales. They asked for an uptime SLA and data residency in us-west1.

Dilip: For success criteria, I'd propose: latency p50 < 300ms, p95 < 900ms on typical query mix; relevance target: nDCG@5 >= 0.7 on their labeled 200-query eval set; embedding recall@10 >= 0.9. Also need a clearly defined prompt/negative example set. Who can own the eval set labeling?

Sam-SE: I can own the eval harness + prompt templates. Recommend we split prompts into: "FAQ short", "contextual followup", and "multi-doc retrieval" buckets. We'll run 1k synthetic queries + their 200 labeled. Also suggest telemetry: tokens per request, cache hit rate, and KV cache miss ratio.

Maya: Great. Ownership: Sam-SE = eval harness & prompts, Dilip = infra perf targets & SLOs, Liam-AM = commercial/pricing. I'll coordinate integration work with their eng lead.

Liam-AM: Re: pricing — can we offer a 6-week POC credit (compute only) plus optional reserved pricing for Dedicated if they convert? Need a ballpark by EOD so I can include in the SOW.

Dilip: For ballpark, assuming their QPS ~ 20 concurrent and avg tokens 120, rough estimate on Dedicated config: 4xA100 equiv, expect ~ $Xk/month. I'll run a capacity calc and share numbers.

security-bot: Security questionnaire (ACME) status: 60% complete. Items pending: KMS integration details, audit log retention period, and SOC2 artifact upload. Owner: Maya to provide customer-facing answers for KMS.

Maya: I'll draft KMS/KYC answers and share by 3pm. Also need SE time for on-call during integration: Sam-SE, can you do a 2-hour window for initial deploy + a 1-hr wrap the next day?

Sam-SE: Yes to both. Suggest blocking: Mon 10-12 PT for deploy, Tue 9-10 PT for validation. I'll update calendar invites.

Dilip: Side note — ACME wants an A/B fallback strategy if quantized model quality drops. Propose automatic fallback policy: if eval metric drop > 5% on control prompts, route to float32 variant for that session. We can wire it via model routing config.

Maya: Nice, include that in the playbook. Also need a short SOW line: "Success criteria gating production conversion: meet relevancy & latency targets on agreed eval set for 2 consecutive weeks." Liam-AM can you add that to the SOW draft?

Liam-AM: Will add. Also asking legal to fast-track MSA addendum for data residency — ETA 48 hours.

deploy-bot: infra window confirmed: us-west1 reserved for POC: 2026-06-02T17:00Z -> 2026-08-02T17:00Z. Burst capacity limited to +25% for first 2 weeks.

Sam-SE: Eval harness snippet (will push to repo):
```python
# sample eval runner
from redwood_eval import EvalHarness
h = EvalHarness(model="redwood-llm-v1", prompts_file="acme_prompts.json")
results = h.run(n=1200)
print(results.summary())
```
I'll attach the real prompt buckets in the PR.

Dilip: For observability, we need these dashboards: per-route latency, token cost, batch size distribution, KV cache hit %. I'll make a readout template.

Maya: Timeline check: Week 0 = kickoff & questionnaire closure, Week 1-2 = prompt labeling + baseline eval, Week 3-4 = integration & perf tuning, Week 5-6 = ramp, dashboarding, and exec review. Can everyone confirm availability windows?

Sam-SE: Confirmed. I'm 0.4 FTE dedicated across weeks 1-4, then 0.2 weeks 5-6.

Dilip: I can support 0.2 FTE for perf tuning and on-call for week 3-4.

Liam-AM: I'll own customer comms and SOW updates. Legal + finance are looped.

Maya: Ok next actions: 1) Sam-SE push initial harness PR with prompt skeleton by EOD, 2) Dilip capacity calc & cost estimate by EOD, 3) Maya draft questionnaire answers by 3pm, 4) Liam-AM push SOW addendum by EOD. Aim to have customer sign-off on scope by Friday.

Liam-AM: I spoke to the buyer — Friday sign-off is realistic if we deliver the SOW + eval plan today.

Sam-SE: PR link: https://git.redwood.dev/acme/poc/pulls/12 (draft) — will convert after reviews.

Dilip: Adding fallback policy config to repo as RFC.

Maya: Thanks team. If no blockers, I'll run the kickoff with ACME at 1pm PT and confirm the milestone dates in the invite. :thumbsup:

Liam-AM: :thumbsup: I'll join kickoff.

security-bot: Note: once KMS answers are posted, auditor will re-run automated checks (ETA 2 hours).

Maya: Closing loop — will post SOW + PR links to thread after send.

Sam-SE: Quick follow-up: do we want to include a small reranking eval (50 queries) as part of success criteria? That helps measure UX uplift.

Dilip: Yes, include rerank nDCG@3 >= 0.65. Add to eval checklist.

Maya: Added. End of thread.
